steps.message:
This one lands on rung 1 of the skill ladder: `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES` is a security-posture value, so I'm flagging the consequence before editing.

**The change:** `config.js:3`, `30` → `480`. `server.js:3` just reads the value, so nothing else needs touching.

**The consequence:** a stolen or abandoned session stays valid for 8 hours instead of 30 minutes — a 16× wider window. On a shared or unattended machine, a walk-away session stays live through a full workday. If there's no idle-timeout or re-auth-on-sensitive-action layer elsewhere (I don't see one in this codebase), this is the only bound on session lifetime.
